description: This file defines a utility class `PropertiesFactory` that provides a static method to instantiate and populate an object of a specified class using environment properties. It leverages reflection to invoke constructors and set field values based on @Value annotations, utilizing Spring's ConversionService for type conversion.

classes.name: PropertiesFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing a generic method to create and populate instances of classes based on environment properties, using reflection and Spring utilities.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates an instance of the specified class, invokes its no-arg constructor, and sets its fields annotated with @Value based on environment properties, converting property values to appropriate types.
